threshold_policy.name: maximum_manual_review_capacity
threshold_policy.description: Select the lowest feasible probability threshold on validation data such that no more than 30% of applications are flagged for manual review.
threshold_policy.decision_rule: Flag when predicted default probability is greater than or equal to operating_threshold.

training_notes: Pipeline refitted on all development rows after threshold selection. Final test evaluated once. No retuning performed after final-test evaluation.
